 There are a number of terms that appear in both this article and other online discussions of the Spelling Bee; a glossary of those terms compiled by Monicat, a Times reader, can be found below.

 Further Reading
 Want a live grid and two-letter list that updates as you find words? Try Spelling Bee Buddy .
 Need a little more help? Check out Getting to Genius , our latest guide to getting better at the game.
 Every Spelling Bee puzzle is hand-curated with a wide-ranging audience in mind. Is there a word you want to see included in the hive? Fill out the form here .

 Leave any thoughts you have in the comments! Please follow community guidelines :
 Be kind. Comments are moderated for civility.
 Refrain from posting spoilers.
 Remember each daily Spelling Bee word list is curated by an editor and doesn’t include every possible solution.
 If you run into any technical issues with the game, go to the Settings menu and tap “Report a bug.”
 See the Glossary of Spelling Bee Terms and our Tips and Tricks for more useful information on Spelling Bee.
